map.蒙特利尔认知评估量表(MoCA)，筛查轻度认知障碍(MCI)和痴呆，总分0-30: Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), screens mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia; total 0-30, >=26 normal
map.📖 查看「记忆力 MoCA 蒙特利尔评估器 使用指南」: 📖 View "Memory MoCA Montreal Cognitive Assessor Guide"
map.MoCA 蒙特利尔认知评估总分 = 各认知域（视空间执行/命名/记忆/注意/语言: MoCA total = sum of cognitive domains (visuospatial-executive/naming/memory/attention/language/abstraction/delayed recall/orientation), max 30; +1 correction if education <=12 years; >=26 normal, 18-25 mild cognitive impairment, 10-17 moderate, <10 severe.
map.MoCA对轻度认知障碍(MCI)的敏感性优于MMSE（90% vs 18%），是: MoCA outperforms MMSE in sensitivity for MCI (90% vs 18%), and is the preferred screening scale for MCI and early AD. +1 if education <=12 years. Domain subtotals aid etiologic differentiation (e.g. AD mainly memory, vascular cognitive impairment mainly executive). Combine with imaging and biomarkers.
map.视空间、命名、注意、延迟回忆多域。: Visuospatial, naming, attention, delayed recall domains.
map.12 项合计 22 分，教育年限≤12 加 1 后 23 分 <26：提示认知障: 12 items total 22, +1 for <=12 years education = 23 <26: suggests cognitive impairment, needs further assessment.
map.通常 <26 提示异常；教育≤12 年加 1 分校正。: Usually <26 suggests abnormality; +1 correction if education <=12 years.
map.满分 30，覆盖注意、执行、记忆、语言、视空间与定向。: Max 30, covering attention, executive, memory, language, visuospatial and orientation.
map.关于「记忆力(MoCA)蒙特利尔评估器」: About the Memory (MoCA) Montreal Cognitive Assessor
map.MoCA蒙特利尔认知评估器，基于蒙特利尔认知评估量表(MoCA)，筛查轻度认知障: MoCA Montreal cognitive assessor, based on the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), screens mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease, covering attention, memory, language, executive function, etc. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
